title: Autopilot repo config
description: The autopilot config of a repo, at .github/autopilot.json.

agents.description: The harness and model for each role.

skills.description: Skills installed for each role. Each entry is one skill directory with a SKILL.md: github.com/<owner>/<repo>[//<path>][#<ref>] (fetched per job with the App token, from a repo that the host watches) or a path under /etc/autopilot/skills on the host.

mode.description: Where the repo's checks run. host: the autopilot host runs them in the repo's dev container and posts autopilot/<check> statuses. ci: the host runs nothing and waits for the repo's own CI, where each name in `required` is a GitHub Actions job on the pull request's head. Only a success passes.

required.description: Checks that must pass before merge.

commands.description: Shell command for each check, such as lint, types and test. It runs in the repo's dev container (.devcontainer/), with no network.

timeout_minutes.description: host: time limit for all checks together. ci: how long the host waits for the repo's CI on one head before it blocks the issue.

preview.description: A command that starts a preview of the app, and its URL. autopilot reads this field but does not use it yet.

merge.description: auto: merge when the checks pass and the risk is low. manual: a person always does the merge.

risk.description: Risk rules in addition to the built-in ones.

high_paths.description: Globs that make a change high risk.

max_diff_lines.description: A diff with more added + deleted lines than this is high risk.

secrets.description: 1Password references to runtime secrets, written by `autopilot secrets set --backend op`. Each one must be op://autopilot/<owner>_<repo>/<NAME> (lowercase owner and repo). The host reads the values for the verify.commands checks only. A reference here wins over a value of the same name in the repo's env file on the host.

fix_rounds.description: Maximum fix rounds after failed checks.

harness.description: claude: Claude Code with the host's Claude token. opencode: OpenCode with a provider API key from secrets.api_keys in host.json.

model.description: Passed to the harness. claude: a Claude model, such as claude-sonnet-5-5. opencode: <provider>/<model>, such as anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5.

effort.description: claude: the --effort level. opencode: the model variant (<model>#<effort>), which the model must have.
